themes.label: Schooling
themes.definition: School fees, tuition, supplies, enrolment, or things for school such as a bicycle to get there.

themes.label: Holidays and leisure
themes.definition: Holidays, trips, camps or leisure activities for the children.

themes.label: Food, health and home
themes.definition: Food, health care, hygiene, water, electricity or housing for the children.

themes.label: More time with the children
themes.definition: More time to spend with or care for the children.

themes.label: Household income
themes.definition: Higher household or business income that helps the children, without a specific use.

themes.label: A child's own business or training
themes.definition: Helped a child start a business or trade, or pay for vocational training.
